subject.why: The lasso is immediately recognisable, featuring a neat coil of thick rope secured with the red leather tie and extending into an open loop with a knot.

category.why: The lasso floats in mid-air with a dynamic three-quarter tilt against a warm red radiating sunburst pattern, fully complying with category 1.

clean.why: No text, logos, borders, UI elements, or characters are present.

framing.why: The composition is well-centered with ample, balanced breathing room on all sides and no cutoffs.

colour.why: Bright and warm colour palette; the golden-tan rope separates cleanly against the saturated warm red sunburst background.

detail.why: The rope is rendered as a clean, smooth form without distracting micro-textures, braiding grooves, or clutter.

style.why: Matches the reference style perfectly with chunky 3D volumes, soft specular highlights, smooth satin sheen, and no outlines.

bg_colour.why: background is red (97% of the background); planned red
